decisions.rationale: Diff grants auditors deletion contrary to the administrator-or-owner rule; 1 of 2 tests fails.
For restricted ASCII input, strip plus casefold satisfies trimming and lowercasing; the committed test passes.
Non-empty behavior and tests pass, but empty behavior changes from None to ValueError while the specification leaves it undefined.
Malformed and out-of-range inputs return 0 instead of raising ConfigError; 1 of 2 tests fails.
The candidate negates the required arithmetic sum, and the committed test fails.

strategy_update: Independently verify exact diffs and tests; abstain only when changed behavior is explicitly unspecified.
